title: Flipper One Tech Specs
summary: Flipper One is a portable multi-tool device designed for security researchers and penetration testers, featuring technical specifications including processor, memory, connectivity options, and supported protocols for interacting with various electronic systems.
problem_solved: Provides security researchers with a portable, all-in-one device for interacting with and analyzing wireless protocols and electronic systems.
why_valuable: democratizes hardware security research by offering an affordable, open-source multi-tool that replaces expensive specialized equipment.
